NP Presspad 1.2.8 — Maintenance

Maintenance release — dependency updates only, no user-facing changes. **No companion plugin update needed.**

## Dependency updates

- **Tiptap** (the editor) 3.29.2 → 3.30.1 — all `@tiptap/*` packages moved together.
- **Electron** 43.3.0 → 43.4.0 (patch/minor within the current major)
- **lucide-react** (icons) 1.30.0 → 1.31.0
- **sanitize-html** 2.17.6 → 2.17.7

## Held back

- **better-sqlite3-multiple-ciphers** 12 → 13 and **@vitejs/plugin-react** 5 → 6 are major bumps, deferred for a human to review.
- **electron-builder** stays pinned at 26.8.1 (a newer publisher regression splits release assets across two draft releases).
